conditions.redistribute3: Keep three; distribute 4 hot partitions as evenly as whole partitions permit
conditions.scale_redistribute6: Scale to six; distribute 4 hot partitions as evenly as whole partitions permit

cost_protocol.starting_conditions: Capture the native three-consumer empty-topic map. Select the 4 lowest-numbered partitions owned by Consumer 2 before any performance outcome is observed. Freeze this hot set and initial ownership for every condition, and verify original pod UIDs, nodes, and resource declarations before traffic.
cost_protocol.interpretation: Compare the complete scheduled responses, including preparation and handover. A capacity-limited condition is a hypothesis, not a guaranteed favorable scaling result. The late cohort is a fixed-window outcome, not called post-recovery unless recovery actually precedes its start.
technical_checks: Previously passed nonempty redistribution monitoring gate
Empty-topic native assignment capture and matching restart
Low-load native 3-to-6 technical trial: 300 aggregate msg/s, 20 warm-up + 100 evaluation + 60 drain; all acknowledgments completed; valid offsets and six active partition owners
cost_protocol.processing_interruption: For explicit actions, retain the verified global last-completion to first-post-resume-processing gap and per-process released-to-resumed intervals. For native scaling, record each moved partition's last old-owner completion to first new-owner processing start, and owner callbacks; a group need not have a global processing pause. Record any observed global no-processing interval separately without treating unaffected consumers as paused.
cost_protocol.transition_and_accumulation: Explicit release_requested to active_verified; also retain scheduled and actual decision times. Native: actual scale decision to first complete fresh six-owner snapshot followed by 10 seconds of valid unchanged ownership. Count distinct acknowledged-but-unfinished records at each endpoint (including warm-up), and report the net change. This is observed accumulation, not causal excess over a no-action counterfactual or exact Kafka offset lag.

recovery.rule: Consecutive valid samples with unchanged owners and nondecreasing offsets. If not observed under continued input, report unconfirmed; drain completion is a separate outcome.

outcomes: Completed evaluation-cohort mean and nearest-rank p99 latency before commit acknowledgment
Distinct successful completion throughput and 10-second bins
Total/per-partition lag and processing backlog, 10-second growth, skew and persistence
Requested consumer CPU/memory integrated over evaluation plus drain
Ownership, offset continuity, unique message identities and monitoring validity
cost_protocol.failure_rule: No performance trial until the monitoring correction is verified. Up to three attempts only for pre-traffic ownership mismatches, preserving rejected preparations. Stop on runtime/identity/offset failure. Retain valid unfavorable outcomes. Restore original shared configuration and three stopped consumer applications.
cost_protocol.study_purpose: Test partition granularity at a rate previously observed to sustain balanced input. Keep 700 messages/s for the first block and at most 800 for any follow-up; retain every valid outcome regardless of direction. Four hot partitions create a different skew pattern from 80/20 across twelve of sixty partitions.
cost_protocol.slo_rationale: For the new trials, one second is the primary experimental completion deadline and 0.5 seconds is a prespecified stricter sensitivity threshold. Balanced 700 messages/s calibration recorded p99 of 0.248 and 0.395 seconds; these observations provide context but do not establish an application requirement or guarantee. Neither threshold is a validated application SLA. Historical 99 ms outcomes retain their original threshold.
cost_protocol.deadline_outcome_definition: At each threshold, count late earliest completions plus unfinished admitted evaluation messages whose deadlines have elapsed at the original observation cutoff; divide by distinct admitted evaluation messages. Report not-yet-expired deadlines as censored and suppress the full-cohort miss fraction if any remain censored or completion clocks are invalid. Completion is before commit acknowledgment. Equality with the deadline is on time.
cost_protocol.assignment_limit: The implemented target balances hot and cold partition counts separately. With four hot partitions, three consumers receive hot counts 2,1,1, while six receive 1,1,1,1,0,0. This is not an optimal load- or capacity-weighted three-consumer assignment; a different assignment may reduce any observed disadvantage.
primary_outcomes: Unfinished evaluation messages after fixed drain
Whole-evaluation-cohort completion p99 reported with unfinished work
secondary_outcomes: Final-two-minute production-cohort latency with unfinished work
CPU and memory usage with coverage
Requested CPU and memory over time
Admitted-cohort completion deadline misses at the primary and prespecified sensitivity thresholds

validation.interpretation: Synthetic completion/offset evidence only; not exactly-once external application effects.

growth_plot_parameters.definition: Change in processing backlog divided by actual elapsed seconds over contiguous, valid, same-owner observations. Missing data and ownership/offset resets restart the window.
